gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Set up your account and start receiving bookings

welcome.title: Welcome to Otium Week
welcome.content:
Otium Week is the all-in-one management system for hospitality, events and services. From booking management to guest CRM, from housekeeping to SPA, everything in one dashboard.

After login, you'll be guided through a setup wizard that helps you:
• Fill in your company details
• Create your first property
• Choose your active modules

firstStructure.title: Creating your first property
firstStructure.content:
A property represents your business: a B&B, hotel, event venue, or any type of service.

1. Go to Properties in the sidebar
2. Click "New property"
3. Enter name, type, capacity and base price
4. Add bookable units (rooms, tables, slots)

Each property gets its own public page where guests can book.

firstBooking.title: Receiving your first booking
firstBooking.content:
Bookings can arrive in two ways:

• Online booking: guests fill in the form on your public page (/book/[id])
• Manual entry: from the Bookings menu → New

Every new booking starts with "Pending" status. You can confirm, cancel or modify it from the detail page.

modules.title: Enabling and disabling modules
modules.content:
Otium Week is modular: you only enable the features you need.

Go to Modules in the sidebar to see all available modules:
• Core: Bookings, Properties, CRM, Housekeeping
• Operations: Maintenance, Staff, Alloggiati Web
• Advanced: SPA, Events, Billing, Catering
• Integrations: AI Concierge, Auto Emails, Calendar Sync

Disabled modules don't appear in the menu.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.description: Booking management, check-in, check-out and calendar

overview.title: Bookings overview
overview.content:
The Bookings page shows all bookings with status filters:
• Pending — new requests to confirm
• Confirmed — confirmed bookings
• Completed — guests who checked out
• Cancelled / No show

Use the search bar to find by name, email or booking code.

checkin.title: Check-in and check-out
checkin.content:
From a booking detail page you can:

1. Check-in: click the "Check-in" button to register the guest's arrival. Fill in Alloggiati Web data if needed.
2. Check-out: click "Check-out" to complete the stay.

Online check-in is available by sending a link to the guest (auto-generated) where they can enter their details and documents before arrival.

calendar.title: Booking calendar
calendar.content:
The calendar shows a timeline view of all properties and units.

• Drag to navigate through time
• Colors indicate booking status
• Click an empty cell to create a new booking
• Click a booking to see details

Counters at the top show today's arrivals, departures and occupancy.

importExport.title: Import and export
importExport.content:
You can import bookings from CSV files (useful for migrating from other systems) and export the booking list.

Required CSV format:
• Required columns: FirstName, LastName, Email, ArrivalDate
• Optional columns: Phone, Property, Unit, DepartureDate, Price, Status
• Separator: comma or semicolon
• Dates in YYYY-MM-DD format

structures.title: Properties & Rooms
structures.description: Property management, units, rates and availability

units.title: Bookable units
units.content:
Units are the individual bookable entities: rooms, apartments, tables, slots.

For each unit you can configure:
• Name and description
• Capacity (guests) and extra beds
• Base price and extra bed price
• Floor and housekeeping status

Units are displayed on the public booking page.

rates.title: Rates and dynamic pricing
rates.content:
Each property supports period rates and rate rules:

• Period rates: different prices for high/low season, holidays, weekends
• Rate rules: automatic discounts for long stays, last minute, early booking

The system automatically calculates the best price for the guest.

availability.title: Availability and synchronization
availability.content:
Availability updates automatically based on bookings.

You can also:
• Manually block dates (closure, maintenance)
• Sync with Booking.com, Airbnb and Google Calendar via iCal
• Export the iCal link from the property page → Sync

guests.title: Guest CRM
guests.description: Guest registry, preferences, history and tags

crm.title: Guest management
crm.content:
The CRM automatically collects guest data from bookings.

For each guest you can see:
• Stay history and total spend
• Preferences (high floor, allergies, etc.)
• Custom tags (VIP, business, family)
• Blacklist for problematic guests

Use filters to segment guests by tag, nationality, spend.

housekeeping.title: Housekeeping
housekeeping.description: Cleaning, room status, linens and operational tasks

overview.title: Cleaning management
overview.content:
The housekeeping board shows the status of all rooms:
• Clean (green) — ready for check-in
• Dirty (red) — needs cleaning
• Cleaning (yellow) — staff working
• Do not disturb — guest request

You can assign tasks with priority (urgent, high, normal, low) and type (cleaning, linen change, inspection).

linens.title: Linens
linens.content:
The linens module manages standard sets and change requests.

Configure the standard set for each unit type (sheets, towels, bathrobes) and track linen change requests with status and priority.

spa.title: SPA & Wellness
spa.description: Treatments, therapists, appointments and clinical declarations

overview.title: SPA module overview
overview.content:
The SPA module manages the entire wellness center operations:
• Treatment catalog with categories, durations and prices
• Wellness paths (treatment combinations)
• Therapist management with schedules and specializations
• Treatment rooms
• Appointment calendar

Guests can book online from the public SPA page.

waiver.title: Clinical declaration (Waiver)
waiver.content:
Before each treatment, the guest fills in a digital clinical declaration:
• Medical conditions
• Allergies
• Pregnancy status
• Body zones to treat/avoid (interactive map)
• Digital signature

The SPA dashboard shows waiver status for each appointment.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Invoices, electronic invoicing and tax data

invoices.title: Invoices and payments
invoices.content:
The invoices section shows invoices issued by the platform for your subscription.

For invoicing your guests, configure billing data in Profile:
• Company name and VAT number
• SDI code and PEC for electronic invoicing
• Tax regime (standard, flat-rate, etc.)

The Service Catalog module lets you manage products with different VAT rates.

reports.title: PMS Reports
reports.content:
The monthly report includes:
• Revenue and RevPAR with previous month comparison
• Occupancy with 30-day forecast
• ADR (Average Daily Rate) and average stay length
• Detail by property and booking sources
• Year-over-year comparison
• Credit schedule
• ISTAT statistics (guest nationalities)
• Tourist tax

Export to PDF or CSV from the top menu.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: AI Concierge, automated emails, channel manager

concierge.title: AI Concierge WhatsApp
concierge.content:
The AI Concierge automatically responds to guest WhatsApp messages 24/7.

Setup:
1. Go to AI Concierge → Settings
2. Choose AI provider (free Ollama, Claude, OpenAI)
3. Enter your API key
4. Write your property info in the System Prompt
5. (Optional) Connect WhatsApp Business for production

Use the Simulator to test without WhatsApp.

autoEmail.title: Automated emails
autoEmail.content:
The system automatically sends three types of emails:

• Pre-arrival reminder: the day before check-in with address and online check-in link
• Post-stay follow-up: the day after check-out with thank you message
• SPA reminder: the day before the appointment

Configure your SMTP server in Profile to send from a custom address.

channels.title: Channel Manager
channels.content:
Sync availability with OTAs (Booking.com, Airbnb, VRBO) via iCal feeds.

1. Go to the property page
2. Copy the iCal link
3. Paste it in the OTA's import settings

The calendar updates automatically every 4 hours. OTA import is available in the Channel Manager section.

cashiering.title: Cash Register & Payments
cashiering.description: Payment registration, daily closing and cash reports

dailyRegister.title: Registering a payment
dailyRegister.content: From the Cash Register section you can record every payment by selecting the payment method (cash, credit card, debit card, bank transfer, satispay). For card payments, specify the card type and last 4 digits. Each transaction is linked to the logged-in operator and to the related booking or service.

dailyClosing.title: Daily cash closing
dailyClosing.content: At the end of your shift, start the cash closing to reconcile payments. Enter the physical cash count and the system automatically calculates the difference between collected and expected amounts. You can add notes to explain any discrepancies. The closing history is always available for review.

cashReports.title: Cash reports
cashReports.content: Cash reports show payment details broken down by payment method, by operator and by period. You can analyze daily and monthly trends, compare different periods and export data to CSV for accounting purposes.

staffManagement.title: Staff Management
staffManagement.description: Staff invitations, roles, permissions and account management

inviting.title: Inviting a staff member
inviting.content: From the Users section you can send email invitations. Choose one of 7 available roles: Admin, Receptionist, Housekeeper, SPA Therapist, Waiter, Maintenance and General Staff. Each role has predefined permissions that determine which sections of the system are accessible. Invitations are valid for 7 days.

registration.title: Invitee registration
registration.content: The invitee receives an email with a registration link. By clicking the link, they access a form where they enter their first name, last name and password. After registration, the account is automatically activated with the assigned role and the user can immediately access the system.

permissions.title: Managing permissions and roles
permissions.content: From the user list you can change each member's role, temporarily deactivate an account or remove it. Deactivated users cannot log in but their data and operation history are preserved. Only admins can manage other users.

foodBeverage.title: Food & Beverage
foodBeverage.description: Menu editor, guest meal choices and kitchen view

menuEditor.title: Daily menu editor
menuEditor.content: From the F&B section you can create daily menus with categories (starters, first courses, main courses, sides, desserts). For each dish, specify name, description, allergens (gluten, lactose, nuts, etc.) and whether it is vegetarian or vegan. Menus are automatically published for guests.

guestChoices.title: Guest meal choices
guestChoices.content: Guests can select dishes online before the meal, indicating any intolerances or dietary preferences. The system collects choices and aggregates them for the kitchen, simplifying preparation and reducing waste.

kitchenView.title: Kitchen view
kitchenView.content: The kitchen view shows daily counts: expected covers, quantity for each ordered dish and allergen summary to manage. This view is designed to be displayed on a kitchen tablet for quick reference during service.

spaAdvanced.title: Advanced SPA
spaAdvanced.description: Gift cards, loyalty program, waiting list and cabin kiosk

giftCards.title: Gift Cards
giftCards.content: You can create gift cards with a custom amount or linked to a specific treatment. Gift cards have a unique code, an expiration date and a trackable balance. When booking a SPA treatment, the guest can redeem the gift card by entering the code. The remaining balance is updated automatically.

loyalty.title: Loyalty Program
loyalty.content: Set up a loyalty program with tiers (e.g. Bronze, Silver, Gold). Guests earn points with each treatment and can redeem them for discounts or free treatments. Define point thresholds for each tier and associated benefits from the Loyalty section.

waitingList.title: Waiting List
waitingList.content: When all slots are booked, guests can join the waiting list. If a cancellation occurs, the system automatically notifies the first person on the list. The module also tracks turnaways (declined requests) to help you size your SPA offering.

cabinKiosk.title: SPA Cabin Kiosk
cabinKiosk.content: Enable kiosk mode on a tablet in each cabin to give the therapist immediate access to the guest's clinical profile, zones to treat/avoid and notes. The therapist can update the appointment status and mark completion directly from the tablet.

kiosk.title: Kiosk & Tablet
kiosk.description: Tablet mode for reception, SPA and guest signing

tabletMode.title: Setting up tablet mode
tabletMode.content: Tablet mode turns any device into a dedicated terminal. At reception, the tablet shows the day's arrivals and departures with quick check-in. In the SPA, each cabin can have a tablet with the therapist view. Enable tablet mode from the device Settings menu.

checkoutSigning.title: Checkout bill signing
checkoutSigning.content: At checkout, the guest can view the charge summary on the tablet and digitally sign the bill. The signature is saved alongside the receipt and can be attached to the invoice. This eliminates the need for paper documents.

cabinView.title: Therapist cabin view
cabinView.content: The cabin tablet shows the therapist the guest's clinical profile: declared medical conditions, allergies, medications, body map with zones to treat and avoid, and preferred pressure. All information comes from the waiver completed by the guest.

gdprPrivacy.title: GDPR & Privacy
gdprPrivacy.description: Data retention, export, anonymization and registration cards

dataRetention.title: Automatic retention policies
dataRetention.content: The system automatically applies data cleanup policies: sensitive SPA data (clinical waivers) is deleted after 40 days from the treatment, while guest contact data is anonymized after 90 days from the last stay. You can customize these intervals from the GDPR section.

dataExport.title: Guest data export (Art. 15)
dataExport.content: Upon guest request you can export all their personal data in JSON or PDF format. The system automatically gathers bookings, payments, communications and SPA data. The export is accessible from the guest profile in CRM, under the GDPR section.

erasure.title: Right to erasure (Art. 17)
erasure.content: From the guest profile you can start the anonymization procedure which replaces personal data with anonymous values while keeping aggregate statistics intact. The system checks for legal retention obligations before proceeding (e.g. tax data for 10 years).

regCards.title: Digital Registration Cards
regCards.content: Customize the terms and conditions shown on Registration Cards from the Reg Card Settings menu. You can configure separate texts for hotel and SPA, in multiple languages. Guest digital signatures are archived with timestamps and can be viewed from the booking.

password.q: How do I change my password?
password.a: Go to Profile from the sidebar. The password change function is available in the Account section. If you're an admin, you can also change it from Settings.

multiStructure.a: Yes, you can create as many properties as you want. Each property has its own units, rates, availability and public page. Go to Properties → New property to add one.

publicPage.q: How does the public booking page work?
publicPage.a: Each property has a public URL (/book/[id]) where guests can see availability, prices and book online. You can embed the link in your website or share it directly.

alloggiati.q: How does the Alloggiati Web module work?
alloggiati.a: The module generates the .txt file in the format required by the Italian Police (Questura). Fill in guest data at check-in (document, nationality, birth municipality) and download the file for submission to the Alloggiati Web portal.

subscription.a: Otium Week offers several plans: Single Event, Monthly Visibility and Premium Partner. Each plan includes different feature levels. You can view and manage your plan from the Subscription section.

smtp.q: Do I need to configure my own email server?
smtp.a: No, it's optional. If you don't configure an SMTP server, emails will be sent from the Otium Week platform. If you prefer to send from your business address, configure SMTP in Profile → Communication channels.

language.q: Can I change the interface language?
language.a: Yes, click the globe icon in the top bar to switch between Italian and English. Your preference is saved automatically.

data.a: Yes, we use HTTPS encryption, PostgreSQL database on Neon with automatic backups, and we comply with GDPR. Guest data can be anonymized from the GDPR & Privacy section.

kioskTablet.q: How does the tablet kiosk work?
kioskTablet.a: Kiosk mode turns a tablet into a dedicated terminal for reception or SPA cabin. At reception it shows arrivals and departures with quick check-in, in the SPA it shows the guest's clinical profile to the therapist. Enable it from device settings.

activateModule.q: How do I activate an additional module?
activateModule.a: Go to Modules in the sidebar. Each module has a toggle to enable or disable it. Enabled modules appear in the main menu, disabled ones are hidden. Some advanced modules require a higher subscription plan.

inviteStaff.q: How do I invite a staff member?
inviteStaff.a: Go to Users in the sidebar and click Invite. Enter the email and select a role (Admin, Receptionist, Housekeeper, etc.). The invitee will receive an email with a registration link valid for 7 days.

createGiftCard.q: How do I create a gift card?
createGiftCard.a: Go to SPA, then Gift Card and click New Gift Card. You can choose a custom amount or link it to a specific treatment. The system generates a unique code the guest can use when booking a SPA treatment.

dailyCashClosing.q: How does the daily cash closing work?
dailyCashClosing.a: At the end of your shift, go to Cash Register and start the daily closing. Enter the physical cash count and the system automatically compares it with recorded payments. You can add notes for any discrepancies and confirm the closing.

configureMenu.q: How do I configure the restaurant menu?
configureMenu.a: Go to F&B, then Menu and create a new daily menu. Add dishes by category (starters, first courses, main courses, desserts), specify allergens and dietary preferences. The menu is automatically published for guest meal selections.

hotel.defaultTerms:
GENERAL CONDITIONS OF STAY

1. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT
Check-in time is from 2:00 PM. Check-out time is by 10:00 AM on the day of departure. Extended stays beyond the agreed time may result in an additional night charge.

2. PAYMENT
Payment for the stay and any extras must be settled at check-out, unless otherwise agreed. Cash, credit cards and bank transfers are accepted.

3. CANCELLATION
Cancellations must be communicated at least 48 hours before the arrival date. In case of no-show, the first night will be charged.

4. DAMAGES
The guest is responsible for any damage caused to the property, furnishings and equipment during the stay.

5. LIABILITY
The property is not responsible for valuables left unattended in rooms. Please use the in-room safe.

6. HOUSE RULES
Smoking is prohibited in all indoor areas. Pets are allowed only by prior arrangement. Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM.

PRIVACY NOTICE
(pursuant to Articles 13-14 of EU Regulation 2016/679 - GDPR)

Data Controller: the accommodation facility indicated on this Registration Card.

Purpose: personal data is collected for the execution of the accommodation contract, to fulfill legal obligations (communication to Police authorities pursuant to Art. 109 TULPS), and for administrative and accounting management.

Legal basis: contract execution, legal obligation, legitimate interest.

Recipients: data may be communicated to competent authorities (Police), IT service providers and the accountant for tax compliance.

Retention: data will be kept for the time necessary to fulfill contractual and legal obligations (10 years for tax data, 5 years for police registration cards).

Rights: the data subject has the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. To exercise your rights, write to the Data Controller.

WELLNESS CENTER GENERAL CONDITIONS

1. BOOKING AND CANCELLATION
Appointments must be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance. In case of no-show or late cancellation, the property reserves the right to charge 50% of the treatment cost.

2. PUNCTUALITY
Please arrive 10 minutes before your appointment. Late arrivals may result in a reduced treatment time.

3. CONTRAINDICATIONS
SPA treatments are contraindicated in case of: fever, skin infections, open wounds, acute inflammatory conditions, first 3 months of pregnancy (unless otherwise indicated by a physician).

4. CLINICAL DECLARATION
The client is required to truthfully declare their health conditions. The property declines any responsibility for problems arising from incomplete or untruthful information.

5. LIABILITY
The property and therapist are not responsible for allergic reactions or adverse effects resulting from undisclosed conditions. The client may stop the treatment at any time.

6. VALUABLES
Please do not bring valuables to treatment areas. The property is not responsible for any loss.
